page.layout: Running head across top: "SYMBOLVM APOST." with page number 119 at top right. Below the head, two parallel columns of text: left column headed "Obiectiones." and right column headed "Responsiones." Each column is read top to bottom. Left column first, then right column. Left column has a line "simpliciter." before the main text. No notes in margins. No block below the text.

main_text.head: Obiectiones.
main_text.p: Nō debuit ei dari nomen aliquod commune Iesus Christus (quod non datum est Iosue, & sacerdotibus plerisque) sed proprium & ei soli competens.
Indigna, & impossibilis est, quæ illius persona datur coniunctio naturarum hypostatica, id est Dei creatoris cum homine creatura.
Impossibilis quoque ei assignatur generatio, Humana, nempe absque Patre, & ex sola matre.
main_text.head: Responsiones.
main_text.p: eo factæ, idque peculiariter: nō autem respectu creationis & conservationis mundi. Ergo dicitur hic Christus Dominus, qua mediator noster est apud Patrem, & homo pro nobis factus: non qua creator noster est, & solum Deus.
Christo huic filio virginis Mariæ conuenit vere & proprie hoc nomē Iesus, vel Christus: cæteris autem typicè nomen Christi (quatenus illius figura quædam fuerunt) aptatur: item & Iesus.

Indigna est Deo hæc vnio hypostatica ratione naturæ humanæ in se cō sideratæ: non est autem Deo indigna ratione finis, id est, vt redimeret homines: & ratione gratię, qua dignatus est eam naturam à se assumptam filius Dei.
Ratione nostri: nō autem ratione Dei (qui est omnipotens) est impossibilis eiusmodi Christi h. iiij.

page.notes: Several words are faint or show-through from the reverse side; the reading of some words in the right column near "Christus" and "fuerunt" is uncertain. The left column is set with a dropped "Iesus" passage that may be partly obscured. Possible transcription uncertainty in the right column's last lines, where "Christi" is followed by the signature "h. iiij." Show-through text in the middle of the page was ignored.
